leakage_guard: Base lag and phase predictions use strict-causal training pairs s+h<t.
The trust selector for origin t only uses previous records whose target_anchor < t.
No future actual values are used for current trust selection.

models.ara_phase_regime_velocity: Regime+velocity ARA phase-flow decoded to native units.
models.selector_direction: Causal selector: use phase only when past completed same-risk bucket says phase has better turn accuracy and tolerable MAE.
models.selector_mae: Causal selector: use phase only when past completed same-risk bucket says phase has lower MAE.
